strategyPoints: With such a short lap, tire management will be key. Expect to see drivers pushing hard from start to finish, but at what cost to their rubber?
The pit window will be tight on this 2.8km layout. A well-timed stop could be the difference between victory and defeat.
Fuel load is less of a concern on this Sprint Short layout, allowing teams to focus on outright pace.
Overtaking opportunities are limited, making qualifying crucial for a strong race result.
The compact nature of the circuit means traffic could be a major factor, especially in the early stages of the race.
With such short lap times, any safety car period could significantly alter the race strategy.
The balance between qualifying pace and race pace is critical here. Finding the right compromise will be key.
The lack of long straights means energy recovery will be key to battery management, especially in the hybrid era.
